name: Word slam over the speaker
description: One to three huge white condensed uppercase words slam onto the picture one after another in the upper-middle of the frame, over the speaker; the key word (or the whole phrase) sits on a slightly tilted orange box, and the impact gives a small shake with white sparks flying off the box.
use_when: A short punchy phrase the speaker stresses and the viewer should feel ('ANYONE', 'IS HARD.', 'NOT AGAIN', 'ZERO SKILLS'): a punchline, a reveal, an emphatic word in a hook.

text.help: 1-3 words, e.g. 'editing is hard.'; fitted to 900 px, wraps to two lines if long

accent_word.help: the word (or run of words) from text that gets the orange box, e.g. 'hard.'; empty = the whole phrase on the box

tilt.help: tilt of the orange box in degrees, -6 to 6 (negative leans up to the right)

position.help: 'upper' (centred near y 620, over the forehead and eyes) or 'middle' (near y 740); kept above the mouth when the face is known
